name: Impedance control
description: Compare realized impedance of controlled-impedance traces to their targets. Needs a stackup (Er, dielectric height, copper thickness) and per-net specs (width, target). Models single-ended and edge-coupled differential impedance for both microstrip (outer layer over one plane) and stripline (inner layer between two planes) via IPC-2141; geometry defaults to microstrip. Not_applicable without stackup + controlled-impedance specs.
what_it_measures: Percentage deviation of calculated trace impedance from specified target impedance.
